summary: Iteration 6 tested the /portfolio integration end to end, plus company site and admin regressions. Backend: 46 pytest tests run, 45 passed. The one failure is test_lead_crud_email_export, which got a 502 because the email provider returned 429 'email rate limit exceeded'. This is an outside rate limit, not a code regression. Added a new suite, test_portfolio_api.py (12 tests, all passing). Frontend: everything requested works except one confirmed bug. The 'Show on the page' (visible) switches in Portfolio Management do nothing on the public /portfolio page. Hiding the Education section and publishing still showed section#education live; reordering sections did work. All content was put back: headline is the original, showInNav=true, sections are back in their original order, and has_unpublished=false. Both test leads were deleted.

minor.issue: Returns 502 'Failed to send email' when the Emergent email integration answers 429 'email rate limit exceeded' (seen in backend.err.log). The portfolio contact still saves the lead, but the email alert is not delivered while rate limited. This is outside our control and the main cause of the single pytest failure.
If the pf:draft document is missing, d is None and d['data'] raises an error, giving a 500 instead of a 404. This is an edge case.

Restoring overwrites pf:draft with the restored data without checking for or warning about unpublished draft edits, so unpublished work is lost silently. The UI confirm text says only 'It goes live immediately.'

ui_bugs.issue: The visible:false flag is ignored everywhere on the public portfolio. Site.jsx maps every data.sections item with no s.visible check, and searching src/portfolio for 'visible' finds no filtering. So the admin 'Show on the page' switches for sections, projects, skills, experiences, achievements, education, buttons and nav_items have no effect. Reproduced: hid Education and published; the public page still rendered section#education. /portfolio/work/<hidden-id> would also still open, even though the sitemap leaves hidden projects out.

issues: The open mobile menu panel stops part-way down the screen, so page content (the Download Résumé button) shows through underneath it. A full-height overlay would look cleaner. Low priority, and possibly the original design.
The 'My Portfolio' label is not translated when the site is switched to Tamil (all other nav items are). Nav data-testids also change in Tamil (nav-home is missing), which existed before this work.

action_items: HIGH: Respect visible===false in the portfolio renderer. Filter data.sections in Site.jsx, and filter the list items in Projects, Experience, Skills, Achievements, Education, buttons/placements, nav_items and footer nav. Simplest option: filter once in pf_public_view on the backend AND on the client, so preview behaves the same. Hidden projects should show NotFound at /portfolio/work/<id>, and nav links to hidden sections should be dropped.
Handle a missing pf:draft in pf_publish (return 404, not a 500).
Optional: make the restore confirm text warn that unpublished draft edits will be replaced.
Optional: translate the 'My Portfolio' nav label in the Tamil (ta) version.
critical_code_review_comments: Site.jsx: sections.map has no s.visible filter, and no visible filtering exists anywhere under src/portfolio (root cause of the HIGH bug).
PortfolioAdmin preview(): window.open runs after an awaited save(), so it is outside the user-gesture tick; popup blockers in Safari/Firefox may block the preview tab when there are unsaved changes.
PortfolioAdmin save(): sets has_unpublished:true even when the saved draft matches the published data (cosmetic status badge).
pf_publish/pf_restore write versions plus pf:published without a transaction; fine for a single admin.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_i18n_testimonials.py (test_approve_unknown_404 now accepts 409; the backend's atomic claim returns 409 for an unknown id)

success_rate.backend: 98% (45/46; the 1 failure is the outside email 429 rate limit)

seed_data_creation: None. Temporary portfolio publishes were made (headline TEST_*, a section hidden and reordered, showInNav off then on), and each was reverted using version restore or re-publish. The portfolio version history now has extra entries (TEST publish, Restored..., Published). Two TEST_ portfolio leads were created and deleted by id.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin field testids follow field-pf-<obj>-<key> (e.g. field-pf-profile-headline, field-pf-settings-showinnav); list items use pf-<key>-item-i / -up-i / -down-i, and list fields use field-pf-<key>-<i>-<field> (e.g. field-pf-sections-6-visible). The confirm dialog OK button is confirm-ok. Get sign-in tickets with /app/scripts/clerk_test_auth.py ticket <email>. Retest: hide a section or project, publish, check that /portfolio drops it, then restore the previous version from the Versions tab. Verified working: legacy redirects (/portfolio/<company-slug> -> /projects/<slug>, /work/:id, /quick-view, /testimonial/*), the portfolio 404 page, client-side navigation back to the company site (no reload), font and theme isolation, no horizontal scroll at 390px, résumé download (PDF attachment), quick-view résumé and print buttons, lightbox, hash scroll from the detail page, admin draft -> preview -> publish -> restore, editor role sees no pf-publish or restore buttons, outsider gets 403.
rca of the issue: Visibility bug: the migrated renderer (portfolio/site/*) was ported from Website 1 without the visible filtering, while the admin editor (F.* with VIS) and the sitemap (p.get('visible', True)) both assume it exists. Fix: filter visible!==false either in the backend pf_public_view or in Site.jsx and the list components.
